author: VANSMITHLAB
title: R/GA
summary: A multidisciplinary creative company in New York since 1977. It repeatedly changed its own model with technology, moving from screen graphics and film production to networked products, services and organisational transformation.

hero_image.alt: A worktable of product lasts and shaped models on paper, system diagrams and fabric swatches, with two people at a desk by a tall city window behind.
hero_image.caption: Product, system and material on one surface: a service designed as an object and a diagram at once.
